survivor_review.reason: Fixture identity always has Some(case ID/name), so batch reporting selects case branches and does not read the legacy numeric run field. Failure selection uses SelectedCase::id independently. Multiplication changes unused numeric metadata only; no implementation-mirroring test was added.

observations: All four initial profiles passed 1501 tests. Strict lint checks then prompted equivalent iterator and test-initializer changes; the final matrix includes both lint targets and formatting.

The targeted snapshot differs from final executable inputs only in equivalent initialization of a test RunLimits.steps field; its exact diff is retained. Generated mutation executable inputs match final sources/tests/examples/configuration.
The regression tests cover a parent cancellation arriving during suite teardown; completion observes it after the independent cleanup allowance is restored.
Generated and targeted campaigns were run sequentially after the initial profile matrix. Reporter BrokenPipe checks execute in an isolated subprocess to avoid inherited-reader races.
limits: Cooperative cleanup requires continued polling and draining started work. Dropping or aborting the future, runtime/process/host termination, stuck OS calls, and uncooperative callbacks do not guarantee completed teardown.
The embedding callback must join and drain all borrowers and must not let borrowed fixture inputs escape the owner lifetime. CLI scheduling enforces this lifetime for admitted cases.
Resource acquisition/handoff is not atomic, external effects are not rolled back, and full signal handling, durable case/run outcomes, and common structured report policy remain separate tasks.
Native assertion callback errors are covered; built-in assertions and expected/collected-failure semantics remain roadmap work.
Local x86_64 GNU/musl debug/release checks do not establish hosted CI results or coverage on other platforms.

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import subprocess, json, hashlib, re, tempfile, os
root=Path.cwd()
out=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="fixtures-",dir=root/"target"))
print(f"validation record: {out / 'summary.json'}",flush=True)
inputs=[p for d in ('src','tests','examples') for p in (root/d).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts]
inputs += sorted((root/'docs').rglob('*.md')) + [root/'README.md']
inputs += [root/p for p in ('Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','.cargo/mutants.toml','scripts/coverage.py')]
record={'complete':False,'started':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'input_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in inputs},'checks':[]}
commands=[('gnu-debug',['cargo','test','--locked']),('gnu-release',['cargo','test','--locked','--release']),('musl-debug',['cargo','test','--locked','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl']),('musl-release',['cargo','test','--locked','--release','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl']),('clippy-gnu',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('clippy-musl',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('format',['cargo','fmt','--all','--','--check'])]
try:
 for label,command in commands:
  print('running '+label,flush=True)
  log=out/(label+'.log')
  with log.open('w') as stream:
   result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=1200,env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2'))
  content=log.read_text()
  rows=re.findall(r'test result: (?:ok|FAILED)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;',content)
  check={'label':label,'command':command,'status':result.returncode,'log':str(log.relative_to(root)),'tests':dict(zip(('passed','failed','ignored'),[sum(int(row[i]) for row in rows) for i in range(3)]))}
  record['checks'].append(check)
  (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps(check),flush=True)
  if result.returncode:
   print(content[-12000:],flush=True)
   raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 record['complete']=True
finally:
 record['finished']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
